name: qwen3_5_27b_hint_pressure_10h
description: Hint-aware 27B pressure benchmark tuned for vLLM 0.22.1 on 2x3090: longer 2-4 block prompts, durable tenant families, unique cold RAG churn, transient pseudo-shared families, and deterministic arrivals.

scenario.global_unit: Stable assistant policy with tool rules, response schema, safety constraints, tenant routing hints, audit tags, and long lived operational context.
scenario.tenant_unit: Tenant catalog metadata, permission boundaries, integration names, data retention rules, field aliases, and formatting preferences remain stable across many requests.
scenario.family_unit: Workflow family instructions describe reusable fields, shared business definitions, prior turn state, escalation rules, and repeated decision criteria for one task family.
scenario.cold_unit: Unique evidence paragraph with one-off ticket notes, retrieval snippets, timestamps, numeric fields, customer details, attachments, and context that should not be reused later.
scenario.ambiguous_anchor_unit: Short campaign template with repeated opening instructions, temporary labels, near-duplicate field names, and partial overlap across a few requests.
scenario.ambiguous_tail_unit: Transient variant evidence with unique suffix data, different user objective, different entity names, different timestamps, and no expected long-term revisit.
